title: Interactive Fillable PDF Form Configuration Schema
description: Supply this exact pure JSON schema contract to any AI model (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek) to generate custom valid form configurations for the Interactive PDF Suite.

form_settings.description: Global form basic details, theme colors, instructions, and summary section labels.

Form_Title.description: Form title displayed on PDF line 1

Form_Subtitle.description: Form subtitle displayed on PDF line 2

Instruction_Point_1.description: Optional in JSON. System-managed mandatory red save rule (auto-injected if omitted)

Instruction_Point_2.description: Instruction point 2 text (Before saving click Generate Summary)

Summary_Button_Text.default: >>>> Click the Button To Generate Summary <<<<
Summary_Button_Text.description: Optional in JSON. System-managed button text

section_rows.description: List of form layout section tuples: [Section_Number, Section_ID, Section_Heading_Title, Layout_Grid_Columns]

field_schema_rows.description: List of field definition tuples: [Field_ID, Section_ID, Field_Label, Field_DataType, Default_Value, Tooltip_Help_Text, Validation_Operator, Validation_Param_Value, Dropdown_Options]

items.description: Section ID matching a SEC_N defined in section_rows
Field label heading displayed on PDF canvas
Tooltip help text shown on hover
Validation parameter value (Required for min_length, max_length, in_range, comparison operators)
Comma-separated list of choices (Only required when Field_DataType is 'choice', 'multi_choice', or 'radio_choice')
